notes: GeoTalk 1.1: Fixes the app closing when an internet call starts — the voice engine now runs on its own protected thread with safer audio settings, based on the real problem reports from GeoTalk 1. NEW protection: if a phone ever closes during call start again, the next call on that phone goes straight to Push-to-Talk automatically instead of closing, and the built-in problem report (Profile → Problem report) records exactly where it stopped. Everything else is kept: near-instant call ringing and setup, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
